messages:
Maya: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands: can someone capture the concrete reasons we won vs lost in Q1 and the top asks? Keep it tactical.
Arjun (Product): From product reviews: wins = stable latency, easy onboarding, solid evals. Losses = pricing friction for bursty use, SSO delays in POCs, and two summarization regressions.
Sasha (Sales): Sales notes: 4 deals cited pricing commit size. Mid-market customers wanted flexible monthly caps, not annual Dedicated. Also billing language confused a couple customers.
Nina (Solutions): In demos, customers asked for clear guidance on quantization tradeoffs. They tried 4-bit and saw hallucinations in summarization examples.
Sean (CS): Support sees same: need a short "how to" for quantization + fallback model suggestions and a one-pager for billing.
Maya: Leadership ask: owners + timelines by next Friday. Prioritize 1 quick win + 1 medium project.
Arjun (Product): Suggested owners: Leo (PM) -> burst tier proposal (quick), Sasha -> billing one-pager (quick), Sean + Eng-ML -> quant guidance + evals (medium), Eng-Platform -> SSO push (medium).
Sasha (Sales): I'll draft the one-pager with verbatim loss language. ETA: Wed.
Sean (CS): I'll put together a checklist and a tiny example config for fallback models. ETA: Tue next week.
Ops-bot: Created GH issues: #5010 billing-one-pager, #5011 burst-tier, #5012 quant-guidance. Reminder set for 7 days.
Maya: Thanks. Please post progress here when you hit ETAs. We'll review at the next all-hands. :thumbsup:
